_readme: Pre-existing duplicate-label sets a HUMAN has ruled benign. Read by
apply_aug21.load_accepted_pre() and by _defect_sweep.py; consulted ONLY under
--fail-on-pre (the strict gate a publishing wave runs). A set listed here prints
'ok-pre' and never blocks; every other pre-existing set prints 'pre' (report) and
blocks under --fail-on-pre.
Shape:  <inst> -> '<locale>/<value_set>' -> {'codes': [...], 'reason': '...'}
A row matches only when its colliding codes are a SUBSET of 'codes', so a set that
grows a third colliding code goes back to being a defect. 'reason' is mandatory and
must say why two codes reading the same text is CORRECT on the tablet - not why it is
inconvenient to fix. A defect the extractor causes is an extractor fix, never a ruling
here (the wave rule: poisoned extract output is an extractor defect, never an override).
The gate already exempts, by construction and without a ruling:
* two codes whose ENGLISH labels are identical (the zero-padded 01/1 pair, the
legacy 8/99 'Other (specify)' pair) - they MUST read the same;
* a map key the current .dcf no longer defines - it renders nothing.
EMPTY on purpose (Task 48, 2026-08-27). Every pre-existing set still standing over a
live value set was hand-checked in <ws>/task-48-report.md section 5 and is a REAL
defect or an open translator question (F3 Q10_CIVIL_STATUS off-by-one, F3 hil
Q34_WHO_DECIDES, F4 war Q128/Q134 and the Balaud pairs, F3 bcl Q2_RELATIONSHIP where
Bikol has one word for son/daughter). None of them is benign, so none is ruled.
